metadata.description: Pocketcall: leave the computer working and take the phone, without finding out in town that it never started.

plugins.name: pocketcall
plugins.description: Seven silent reasons an evening away never works, checked before you leave; the four minutes at the door and the thirty seconds you repeat every time; how to answer a person who is reading on a phone; and, on a work account, the built-in remote, a cloud session or SSH and tmux - whichever the company allows. In five languages.
